name: web_search
description: Search the public web and return a short list of results (url, title, snippet). Used ONLY by the Catalog Curator to research a SaaS tool that is not yet in the catalog — never on the core analysis path. Every finding you use MUST be attributed to the sourceUrl it came from; never state a fact this tool did not return.
note: Requires FIRECRAWL_API_KEY (see .env.example). Free Firecrawl access was provided for the HackOn 2026 AI Company track — get your own key at https://www.firecrawl.dev if reusing this outside that track. Never commit a real key to this repo.

query.description: Focused search query, e.g. "Notion API pricing plans" rather than just "Notion".
